title: Detailed hammer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='12' height='54' rx='4' fill='#C77A3A'/>
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='12' height='54' rx='4' fill='none' stroke='#E8A05C' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- handle wood grain -->
  <line x1='50' y1='44' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#A85E22' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='3 4'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='50' x2='47' y2='84' stroke='#D99050' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 5'/>
  <!-- grip band -->
  <rect x='43' y='72' width='14' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <rect x='43' y='72' width='14' height='2' rx='2' fill='#B06A2A'/>
  <!-- metal head -->
  <rect x='18' y='18' width='64' height='28' rx='5' fill='#8FA5B5'/>
  <rect x='18' y='18' width='64' height='28' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#C8DCE8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- top highlight -->
  <rect x='22' y='20' width='56' height='5' rx='2' fill='#D4E6F2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- bottom shadow band -->
  <rect x='20' y='40' width='60' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6B8296'/>
  <!-- left striking face -->
  <rect x='14' y='20' width='6' height='24' rx='2' fill='#A9BECD'/>
  <rect x='14' y='20' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#D4E6F2'/>
  <!-- right striking face -->
  <rect x='80' y='20' width='6' height='24' rx='2' fill='#A9BECD'/>
  <rect x='80' y='20' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#D4E6F2'/>
  <!-- neck connector between head and handle -->
  <rect x='42' y='36' width='16' height='8' rx='3' fill='#7C94A6'/>
  <rect x='42' y='36' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A9BECD'/>
  <!-- head rivet details -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#6B8296'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='32' r='1' fill='#C8DCE8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#6B8296'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='1' fill='#C8DCE8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#6B8296'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='32' r='1' fill='#C8DCE8'/>
  <!-- claw curve hint (pulling claw not visible from front) -->
  <rect x='48' y='26' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#A9BECD' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
